lighting: Warm tungsten bulb acts as the main light source, supplemented by faint cool ambient light from the alley entrance, creating a soft contrast between the warm interior and the cold deep night outside.
grade: Low-saturation, medium-high contrast color grade, with warm yellow tones for interior lit areas and cool blue-gray tones for shadow and outdoor areas, to highlight the warm, welcoming atmosphere of the late-night noodle shop against the cold city night.
